## What does this PR do?

A short description of the change.

## Related issues

`Closes #N` for the issue this fixes (the in-progress label and the release milestone follow from it). Do not use a closing keyword for an issue the change only touches.

## Performance changes

For a change that claims a speed or memory difference: the timed A/B result (`ab.py`, with the noise run), or say why none applies. Leave this out otherwise.

## Docs

Pages under `docs/` and `README.md` that describe what changed, updated in this PR, or why none needs it.

## Checklist

- [ ] A regression test fails on the old code and passes on the new
- [ ] The test suite that the change can affect passes
- [ ] `uvx pre-commit run --files <changed files>` passes
